title: A new Olympic partnerships role at 160over90
intro: One new LA role today: Olympic Account Manager, Partnerships at 160over90 (Publicis), based in Beverly Hills. It's built around Team USA and LA28 sponsorship work for a financial-services client, which lines up with the partnerships side you liked in #4. Your other top picks are still open.

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Verified live Nov 6 on LinkedIn (posted about a day ago; applications close around Nov 27).

notes: Today's search covered SMCP, CHANEL, L'Oréal (El Segundo), Coty, Sol de Janeiro, Clarins, Diptyque, Polène, Accor/Fairmont, Publicis Groupe agencies (160over90, Team One, Influential), Hermès, Cartier, Lacoste, and LinkedIn listings across LA County from the past week.
SMCP Group: Greenhouse shows about 59 US/Canada openings, all boutique/store retail (plus a Montreal retail brand manager). No marketing/brand/partnerships roles.
Sol de Janeiro: marketing roles are New York Metropolitan only right now (no LA).
L'Oréal El Segundo: the only marketing opening still listed is #47 Manager, US Marketing (NYX).

Also seen but not numbered: 160over90 Account Director, Partnerships (Beverly Hills; director-level, too senior), Sephora Assistant Marketing Manager Influencer Marketing & Talent Relations (LA Studio; could not confirm still live on LVMH careers), and Fairmont Century Plaza Marketing Manager (no longer on Accor careers).
Closed earlier: #12 Clarins Sales & Education Executive (still closed).

jobs.title: Olympic Account Manager, Partnerships
jobs.location: Beverly Hills, CA (also listed for New York)
jobs.posted_label: Listed on LinkedIn about a day ago
jobs.french_tie: 160over90 is part of Publicis Groupe (Paris HQ).
jobs.travel: The posting asks for the ability to travel 30% of the time (no destinations named).
jobs.why: A partnerships account role tied to LA28 and Team USA: you'd manage a National Governing Body sponsorship for a financial-services client, keep rights-holder approvals moving, coordinate activations across marketing, hospitality, and events, and put together client-ready decks and plans. Relationship management and executive-facing work carry over from Gartner, and it's at the same Publicis agency as the Talent & Partnerships role you liked (#4).
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 5+ years in sponsorship, partnership, account, or sports marketing (agency, property, rights holder, or brand). Applications are expected to close around Nov 27, 2026.
jobs.status: Brand new listing — apply soon if you're interested.
